name: WF03 — Exact Voice + Script Fit Loop

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id)
SELECT i.job_id AS requested_job_id,j.id AS job_id,j.topic,j.fact_primary_title,j.language_code,j.target_duration_seconds,j.content_model_version,j.script_text,j.script_support,j.story_package,j.duration_preflight,
       j.status,j.current_stage,j.voiceover_path,j.voiceover_duration_seconds,j.script_fit_passes,j.id IS NOT NULL AS job_exists,
       COUNT(s.id)::int AS scene_count
FROM input i LEFT JOIN public.jobs j ON j.id=i.job_id LEFT JOIN public.scenes s ON s.job_id=j.id
GROUP BY i.job_id,j.id,j.topic,j.fact_primary_title,j.language_code,j.target_duration_seconds,j.content_model_version,j.script_text,j.script_support,j.story_package,j.duration_preflight,j.status,j.current_stage,j.voiceover_path,j.voiceover_duration_seconds,j.script_fit_passes;

WITH u AS (
 UPDATE public.jobs j SET status='processing',current_stage='voiceover',last_error=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE j.id=$1::uuid AND j.content_model_version='staged_v1' AND j.status='processing' AND j.current_stage='script'
   AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(j.voiceover_path,'')),'') IS NULL AND j.voiceover_duration_seconds IS NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.scenes s WHERE s.job_id=j.id)
 RETURNING j.id
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u) AS ready_to_run;

parameters.jsCode: const t=$input.first().json,j=$('Require Eligible Voiceover Job').first().json;if(t.ready_to_run!==true)throw new Error(`Job ${j.job_id} could not enter voiceover stage`);const edgeVoices={en:'en-US-AndrewNeural',pl:'pl-PL-MarekNeural',ru:'ru-RU-DmitryNeural',uk:'uk-UA-OstapNeural'},piperVoices={en:'en_US-norman-medium',pl:'pl_PL-darkman-medium',ru:'ru_RU-dmitri-medium',uk:'uk_UA-mykyta-high'},voice=edgeVoices[j.language_code],piperVoice=piperVoices[j.language_code];if(!voice||!piperVoice)throw new Error('Unsupported language');if(j.duration_preflight?.exact_tts_required!==true)throw new Error('Exact TTS contract is missing');return [{json:{job_id:j.job_id,language_code:j.language_code,target_duration_seconds:Number(j.target_duration_seconds),provider:'microsoft_edge_readaloud',model:'edge_neural',voice,edge_fallback_voice:voice,piper_fallback_voice:piperVoice,script_text:j.script_text,script_support:j.script_support,story_package:j.story_package,planned_word_min:Number(j.duration_preflight?.target_word_min??0),planned_word_max:Number(j.duration_preflight?.target_word_max??0),fit_pass:Number(j.script_fit_passes??0),max_fit_passes:1,fit_history:[]}}];

const stored=$input.first().json;let ctx;try{ctx=$('Resume Rewritten Voiceover').all().at(-1)?.json}catch{}if(!ctx)ctx=$('Prepare Continuous Voiceover').first().json;const path=String(stored.voiceover_path??'').trim(),duration=Number(stored.duration_seconds),bytes=Number(stored.bytes);if(!path||!Number.isFinite(duration)||duration<=0||!Number.isFinite(bytes)||bytes<=0)throw new Error('TTS returned invalid voiceover metadata');const provider=String(stored.provider??''),model=String(stored.model??''),voice=String(stored.voice??''),edgeOk=provider==='microsoft_edge_readaloud'&&model==='edge_neural'&&voice===ctx.edge_fallback_voice,piperOk=provider==='self_hosted_piper'&&model==='piper-tts-1.2.0'&&voice===ctx.piper_fallback_voice;if(!edgeOk&&!piperOk)throw new Error('Exact TTS provider/voice contract changed');if(Number(stored.rate_percent)!==0||Number(stored.post_tempo_factor)!==1)throw new Error('Speech-speed manipulation is forbidden');const wt=stored.word_timing,expectedTimingProvider=edgeOk?'microsoft_edge_readaloud':'self_hosted_piper_faster_whisper';if(!wt||wt.version!=='provider-word-timing-v1'||wt.provider!==expectedTimingProvider||!String(wt.audio_sha256??'').trim()||!String(wt.script_sha256??'').trim()||!Array.isArray(wt.words)||!wt.words.length)throw new Error('Exact real-audio word timing is missing');if(piperOk&&(String(wt.alignment_model??'')!=='Systran/faster-whisper-small@536b0662742c02347bc0e980a01041f333bce120'||String(wt.alignment_runtime??'')!=='faster-whisper-1.2.1-cpu-int8'))throw new Error('Self-hosted Piper alignment identity changed');if(Math.abs(Number(wt.duration_seconds)-duration)>0.002)throw new Error('Word timing duration does not match final WAV');let previousEnd=0;for(let i=0;i<wt.words.length;i++){const word=wt.words[i]??{},start=Number(word.start_seconds),end=Number(word.end_seconds);if(!String(word.text??'').trim()||!Number.isFinite(start)||!Number.isFinite(end)||start<previousEnd-0.002||end<=start||end>duration+0.002)throw new Error(`Invalid exact word timing ${i+1}`);previousEnd=end;}const previous=Array.isArray(ctx.fit_history)?ctx.fit_history:[],fit_history=[...previous,{fit_pass:Number(ctx.fit_pass??0),duration_seconds:Number(duration.toFixed(3)),word_count,script_text:text,provider}].slice(-4);return [{json:{...ctx,voiceover_path:path,duration_seconds:duration,bytes,provider,model,voice,word_timing:wt,word_timing_path:String(stored.word_timing_path??''),duration_fit,target_min_seconds:Number(min.toFixed(3)),target_max_seconds:Number(max.toFixed(3)),fit_history,tts_failover_used:stored.failover_used===true}}];

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
 SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,$2::text AS voiceover_path,$3::numeric AS voiceover_duration,$4::text AS provider,$5::text AS model,$6::text AS voice,$7::jsonb AS timings,$8::text AS final_script,$9::jsonb AS final_support,$10::smallint AS fit_passes,$11::jsonb AS story_package
), locked AS (
 SELECT j.id FROM public.jobs j,input i
 WHERE j.id=i.job_id AND j.content_model_version='staged_v1' AND j.status='processing' AND j.current_stage='voiceover'
   AND j.story_package->>'version' IN ('inventory-first-story-v1','visual-facts-story-v1','storyboard-first-v1')
   AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(j.voiceover_path,'')),'') IS NULL AND j.voiceover_duration_seconds IS NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.scenes s WHERE s.job_id=j.id)
 FOR UPDATE
), parsed AS (
 SELECT x.* FROM input i CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(i.timings) AS x(
   scene_number integer,story_unit_id text,claim_id text,asset_id text,narration text,narration_support_evidence_ids jsonb,beat_start_seconds numeric,beat_end_seconds numeric,duration_seconds numeric,status text
 )
), story_units AS (
 SELECT l.id,(u.ordinality)::int AS scene_number,u.value FROM locked l,input i
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(i.story_package->'units') WITH ORDINALITY u(value,ordinality)
), valid AS (
 SELECT p.* FROM parsed p JOIN story_units s USING(scene_number)
 WHERE p.scene_number>0 AND NULLIF(BTRIM(p.narration),'') IS NOT NULL AND p.status='timed'
   AND p.story_unit_id=s.value->>'unit_id' AND p.claim_id=s.value->>'claim_id' AND p.asset_id=s.value->>'asset_id'
   AND p.narration=s.value->>'narration' AND p.narration_support_evidence_ids=s.value->'evidence_ids'
   AND p.beat_start_seconds>=0 AND p.beat_end_seconds>p.beat_start_seconds AND p.duration_seconds>0
   AND ABS((p.beat_end_seconds-p.beat_start_seconds)-p.duration_seconds)<=0.01
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p.narration_support_evidence_ids) q(evidence_id)
     WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.job_evidence je WHERE je.job_id=s.id AND je.evidence_id=q.evidence_id))
), ok AS (
 SELECT l.id FROM locked l,input i
 WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(i.voiceover_path),'') IS NOT NULL AND i.voiceover_duration>0
   AND i.story_package->>'version' IN ('inventory-first-story-v1','visual-facts-story-v1','storyboard-first-v1')
   AND jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'units') BETWEEN 2 AND 12
   AND jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'assets')=jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'units')
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM valid)=jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'units')
   AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT scene_number) FROM valid)=jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'units')
), ins AS (
 INSERT INTO public.scenes(job_id,scene_number,narration,narration_support_evidence_ids,beat_start_seconds,beat_end_seconds,duration_seconds,status)
 SELECT o.id,v.scene_number,v.narration,v.narration_support_evidence_ids,v.beat_start_seconds,v.beat_end_seconds,v.duration_seconds,'timed'
 FROM ok o CROSS JOIN valid v ORDER BY v.scene_number RETURNING job_id
), upd AS (
 UPDATE public.jobs j SET voiceover_path=i.voiceover_path,voiceover_duration_seconds=i.voiceover_duration,voiceover_provider=i.provider,voiceover_model=i.model,voiceover_voice=i.voice,script_text=i.final_script,script_support=i.final_support,story_package=i.story_package,script_fit_passes=i.fit_passes,visual_search_queries_en=NULL,last_error=NULL,updated_at=now()
 FROM input i,ok o WHERE j.id=o.id AND j.id=i.job_id RETURNING j.id,j.status,j.current_stage
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM ins) AS units_inserted,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) AS job_updated,
       (SELECT status FROM upd LIMIT 1) AS status,(SELECT current_stage FROM upd LIMIT 1) AS current_stage,$2::text AS voiceover_path,$3::numeric AS voiceover_duration_seconds,
       jsonb_array_length($11::jsonb->'units') AS story_unit_count;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json,j=$('Require Eligible Voiceover Job').first().json;if(r.job_updated!==true)throw new Error(`Voiceover job update failed for ${j.job_id}`);if(Number(r.units_inserted)!==Number(r.story_unit_count)||Number(r.story_unit_count)!==Number(j.story_unit_count))throw new Error(`Timed story units persisted ${r.units_inserted}/${j.story_unit_count}`);if(r.status!=='processing'||r.current_stage!=='voiceover')throw new Error(`Unexpected one-shot voice state ${r.status}/${r.current_stage}`);const d=Number(r.voiceover_duration_seconds);if(!String(r.voiceover_path??'').trim()||!Number.isFinite(d)||d<=0)throw new Error('Persisted voiceover metadata is invalid');return [{json:{job_id:j.job_id,voiceover_complete:true,total_audio_duration_seconds:d,story_unit_count:Number(r.story_unit_count)}}];

parameters.query: UPDATE public.jobs SET status='failed',current_stage='voiceover',last_error=$2::text,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid RETURNING id AS job_id,status,current_stage,last_error;

').trim(),speech=v=>clean(v).replace(/\s+\/\s+/gu,' ').replace(/\s+\|\s+/gu,' ').replace(/\s+(?:→|->)\s+/gu,' ').trim(),wordRx=/[\p{L}\p{N}]+(?:[’'\-][\p{L}\p{N}]+)*/gu;let story rewrite lost story package');const desired=Number(base.desired_word_target),minUnitWords=Number(base.min_unit_words??6),expected=old.units.map(u=>clean(u.unit_id)),rows=Array.isArray(o?.units)?o.units:[];if(!Number.isInteger(desired)||rows.length!==expected.length)throw unit identity');const units=[];for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){const row=rows[i]??{},unitId=clean(row.unit_id),narration=speech(row.narration),tokens=narration.match(wordRx)??[];if(unitId!==expected[i])throw new Error(`duration story rewrite changed unit order at ${i+1}`);if(!narration||tokens.length<minUnitWords)throw new Error(`duration story rewrite starved frozen unit ${unitId}`);if(!clean(old.units[i].grounded_claim))throw new Error(`duration story rewrite missing frozen grounded claim for ${unitId}`);const body=narration.slice(0,-1);if(!/[.]$/u.test(narration)||/[.!?]/u.test(body))throw new Error(`duration story rewrite sentence for ${unitId} is not one complete declarative sentence`);if(/(?:\s\/\s|\s\|\s|→|->)/u.test(narration))throw new Error(`duration story rewrite narration for ${unitId} contains forbidden separators`);units.push({...old.units[i],narration});}const story={...old,units},script=units.map(u=>u.narration).join(' '),wc=script.match(wordRx)?.length??0,lower=Number(base.desired_word_min),upper=Number(base.desired_word_max);if(!Number.isInteger(lower)||!Number.isInteger(upper)||lower<1||upper<lower||wc!==desired)throw new Error(`duration story rewrite word count ${wc} missed exact target ${desired}`);const support=units.map((u,i)=>({segment_number:i+1,unit_id:u.unit_id,evidence_ids:[...u.evidence_ids],source_ids:[...u.evidence_ids],text:u.narration,transform:'inventory_duration_rewrite_same_grounded_claim'}));return [{json:{job_id:base.job_id,language_code:base.language_code,target_duration_seconds:Number(base.target_duration_seconds),provider:base.provider,model:base.model,voice:base.voice,edge_fallback_voice:base.edge_fallback_voice,piper_fallback_voice:base.piper_fallback_voice,script_text:script,script_support:support,story_package:story,fit_pass:Number(base.next_fit_pass),max_fit_passes:Number(base.max_fit_passes??1),fit_history:Array.isArray(base.fit_history)?base.fit_history:[],duration_controller_mode:String(base.duration_controller_mode??'proportional_measured_duration'),duration_rewrite_mode:'inventory_units_exact_total_words_grounded_claim_v3'}}];

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.jobs
SET script_text=$2,script_support=$3::jsonb,story_package=$4::jsonb,script_fit_passes=$5,updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='processing' AND current_stage='voiceover'
  AND story_package->>'version' IN ('inventory-first-story-v1','visual-facts-story-v1','storyboard-first-v1')
  AND jsonb_array_length(story_package->'units')=jsonb_array_length($4::jsonb->'units')
RETURNING id::text AS job_id,script_fit_passes;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;const x=$('Apply Duration Rewrite').first().json;if(!r.job_id)throw new Error('duration rewrite did not persist');return [{json:x}];

const item=$json,unitOrder=Array.isArray(item.unit_order)?item.unit_order.map(x=>String(x??'').trim()).filter(Boolean):[],desired=Number(item.desired_word_target),minUnitWords=Number(item.min_unit_words);if(unitOrder.length<2||new Set(unitOrder).size!==unitOrder.length||!Number.isInteger(desired)||!Number.isInteger(minUnitWords)||desired<unitOrder.length*minUnitWords)throw new Error('duration rewrite unit schema target is invalid');const response_schema={type:'object',additionalProperties:false,properties:{units:{type:'array',minItems:unitOrder.length,maxItems:unitOrder.length,items:{type:'object',additionalProperties:false,properties:{unit_id:{type:'string',enum:unitOrder},narration:{type:'string',minLength:1,maxLength:900}},required:['unit_id','narration']}}},required:['units']};const model_request={route:'storyboard',prompt:item.rewrite_prompt,temperature:0.05,response_format:'json',response_schema};return {json:{...item,model_request}};
